symptom: Outcome Ledger JSON Schema minLength:1 admits whitespace-only identity and refundReason strings that the TypeScript runtime rejects; a generic \S would also disagree across ECMAScript and Python on U+FEFF/U+0085.
lesson: JSON Schema minLength:1 does not enforce the ECMAScript trim-based nonblank runtime contract; explicit code-point ranges avoid cross-validator \S divergence.
guardrail: For Outcome Ledger identity and refundReason fields, use the exact ECMAScript trim whitespace complement pattern; test U+FEFF, U+0085 and all whitespace code points against runtime and JSON Schema. Reuse the Forward Vault unicode parity guardrail.
